doc.title: Lew Soloff interviewed by Monk Rowe, Scottsdale, Arizona, April 16, 2000

title: Introduction at the Paradise Valley Jazz Party
summary: Rowe introduces Soloff and praises his versatility; Soloff says he has enjoyed it all.

story.theme_name: Opening the interview: Monk Rowe's welcome and archive boilerplate
story.community_name: Opening the Hamilton College interview: introductions and boilerplate

blocks.x: We are filming at the Paradise Valley Jazz Party in Scottsdale, Arizona and my name is Monk Rowe. And it’s a great pleasure to have Lew Soloff with me, who is one of my favorite players. And I think when I look at your resume I’m trying to find someone who’s been doing more versatile work than you over the years. Difficult.
Well thank you. I mean I’ve enjoyed it. I’ve really enjoyed all of it. I’ve enjoyed the different things that I’ve done.
